rationale: The assistant reached the correct hidden cause (torn/flattened freezer door gasket) and gave a sound, model-number-led route to buying the right seal with sensible fitting caveats and unplug/full-defrost advice. It opened weakly by leaning on 'a blocked or frozen defrost drain' and auto-defrost components ('defrost heater, sensor/thermostat') despite the customer saying they manually defrosted a static freezer, and it kept the drain as a fallback in the final message; the attached 'Fridge not cooling' card was also off-topic. No fabricated evidence, no unsafe steps, no looping, and the part recommendation was justified only after the seal damage and paper test were confirmed.
